post.description: Available to workspace admins in workspaces with audit logs enabled; other API keys receive `403`. Returns audit events within the available access window ordered by `(occurred_at, event_id)`. `cursor` is an opaque position valid only with the same order. Send the intended filter with every request, including continuations; changing it returns matching events after the cursor position. Omit `cursor` from the response when there is no next page. A query that exceeds the request deadline returns `504`; retry with a narrower filter or time range. The [audit event catalog](/compliance/audit-logs) documents the `resources` each event type carries.

get.description: Returns the Clay search query reference document (markdown), covering the queryable fields and the query grammar. Use it to author a Clay advanced search query before creating a query-mode search. Pass `sections` to fetch only the parts a query needs; without it, every section is returned.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of reference sections to return. Valid sections: grammar (query grammar), rules (scopes, functions, and query policies), examples (example queries), people-fields (people and experience fields), company-fields (company fields), company-people-fields (people predicate fields used inside company queries), job-fields (job posting fields), workspace-resources (audience and table references; only returned for CLI credentials). Sections are returned in a fixed order regardless of request order. Omit to receive every section; request only the sections you need.
parameters.name: sections

post.description: Runs a structured query against Clay table data and returns records with field metadata. Results are paginated: pass the returned cursor back to fetch the next page. Scans return rows in least-recently-updated-first order and reflect writes that land while you paginate — a scan returns every record visible when it started and picks up records written while it runs, and a record updated mid-scan can be returned again with fresher data, so deduplicate by id if you need each record once.
post.summary: Run a structured query across one or more tables

post.description: Execute a Clay workflow-run query. A `select` query returns matching runs newest-first with a `cursor` for the next page; a `count` query returns the number of matching runs. Get the query grammar with GET /workflows/runs/query/reference. Results are read from an eventually-consistent replica (replication lag is typically a few seconds), so a just-created or just-transitioned run may briefly be missing or show its prior status.

get.description: Returns the Clay workflow-run query reference document (markdown), covering the queryable run fields, node predicates, content search, and the query grammar. Use it to author a workflow-run query.
